references.text: Earlier in the same chapter where Aaron waves the Levites as a wave offering to the Lord, the same ritual described here
The Levites were cleansed and Aaron waved them as a wave offering before the Lord, fulfilling the command given in verse 13
The Levites are presented to Aaron the priest to serve him, the same concept of presenting the Levites before Aaron
The wave offering ritual (tenufah) performed before the Lord, the same type of offering used for the Levites
Aaron and his sons receive the wave offering, parallel to the Levites' role as a wave offering given to the priestly family
The Levites are given as a gift to Aaron and his sons from the children of Israel, explaining why they are presented before Aaron
